statement_token: "Let ${\\cal K}$ be a complex of odd dimension. A zigzag in ${\\cal K}$ has a signature, recording the numbers of intersections of the zigzag with the relevant types of faces. **Zero-signature conjecture.** The signature of every zigzag in ${\\cal K}$ is $(0,0)$. The claim concerns the uniform intersection behaviour of zigzags in odd-dimensional complexes; the supplied text gives no evidence that it has been proved or disproved."
